name: cron_explain
description: Explain a cron expression in English and Spanish and list its next runs after a given date-time in an IANA time zone, DST-aware. Reads the five crontab fields (or six with a leading seconds field), names, lists, ranges, steps and the @daily-style macros, applies Vixie cron's rule that day-of-month and day-of-week are ORed when both are restricted, and accepts the Quartz/cronie L, W, # and ? extensions, flagged as non-standard. Each field's expanded values are returned too.

expression.description: e.g. "30 4 1,15 * 5", "@daily", or a whole crontab line (the rest is reported as the command)

seconds.description: The expression starts with a seconds field (Spring/Quartz style)

from.description: ISO 8601 date-time after which runs are listed; required when count > 0. Without an offset it is local to timezone

count.description: Number of next runs; 0 explains only

dst.description: A local time removed by a spring-forward gap: skip it, or run at the first instant after the gap

output.explanation_en: At 04:30, on day-of-month 1 and 15 or on Friday.
output.explanation_es: A las 04:30, los días 1 y 15 del mes o los viernes.

catalog.source: crontab(5) of Vixie cron / cronie (field ranges, names, steps, macros, the day-of-month/day-of-week OR rule and its first-character-is-* test); Quartz CronTrigger for L, W, # and ?; time zones from the IANA tz database through Python zoneinfo
